quests.question: She trained for months, but her name wasn't on the team list; she felt _____.
quests.explanation: Months of training and then no place on the list would let anyone down, so disappointed fits.

quests.question: Ana studies at night, works at weekends and never skips class; she is very _____.
quests.explanation: Studying at night, working weekends and never skipping class show steady effort: hardworking.

quests.question: Our teacher gives detention for one late arrival and allows no excuses; she is _____.
quests.explanation: Detention for a single late arrival and no excuses show firm rules, so strict fits; lenient contradicts.

quests.question: With a guard, cameras and a double lock, the vault is extremely _____.
quests.explanation: A guard, cameras and a double lock all protect the vault, so secure fits; vulnerable contradicts.

quests.question: At every meeting, Chen says what he thinks, even about the boss; he is _____.
quests.explanation: Saying what he thinks at every meeting, even about the boss, shows he speaks freely: outspoken.

quests.question: After a double shift on her feet, the nurse dropped into a chair, _____.
quests.explanation: A double shift on her feet and dropping into a chair show deep tiredness, so weary fits.

quests.question: Able to bend into shapes that stiffer athletes could never match, the gymnast was wonderfully _____.
quests.explanation: Bending into shapes that stiffer athletes can't match shows flexibility, so supple fits.

quests.question: The new neighbour waved, introduced herself and offered us cake; she seems _____.
quests.explanation: Waving, introducing herself and offering cake are warm gestures, so friendly fits; hostile contradicts.

quests.question: After the long climb, the porter put down the bags and wiped his brow, sighing _____.
quests.explanation: A long climb, dropped bags and a wiped brow show real exhaustion, so wearily fits; briskly contradicts.

quests.question: The bus broke down twice this week and was late every day; it is _____.
quests.explanation: Two breakdowns and daily lateness mean you can't count on it, so unreliable fits.

quests.question: After two weeks of rain, the river barely moved and the whole town felt _____.
quests.explanation: A barely moving river and a damp town suggest slow, heavy mood, so sluggish fits; lively contradicts.

quests.question: Weeks of illness had left her cheeks hollow and her frame skeletal; she looked _____.
quests.explanation: Hollow cheeks and a skeletal frame show thin, haggard looks, so gaunt fits; plump contradicts.

quests.question: Asked about the missing money, he folded his arms and answered _____.
quests.explanation: Folded arms when questioned about missing money show guardedness, so defensively fits.

quests.question: Unsure it was safe, the boy put one toe in the lake and then stepped in _____.
quests.explanation: Testing the water with one toe shows hesitant caution, so tentatively fits; boldly contradicts.

quests.question: The hosts greeted every guest with a handshake and a smile, welcoming them _____.
quests.explanation: A handshake and a smile for every guest show friendly warmth, so cordially fits; coldly contradicts.

quests.question: When the baby said her first word, her parents cried happily and hugged; they were _____.
quests.explanation: Happy tears and hugging at a baby's first word show great joy, so overjoyed fits.

quests.question: The shopkeeper grunted, never looked up and tossed the change on the counter; he was _____.
quests.explanation: Grunting, not looking up and tossing the change show bad-tempered rudeness: surly.

quests.question: At £300 a month, leaving enough for food and fares, the room is _____ for students.
quests.explanation: £300 that still leaves money for food and fares is within a student's means, so affordable fits.

quests.question: After weeks indoors without sunlight, his skin looked yellowish and _____.
quests.explanation: Weeks without sunlight leave skin pale and yellowish, which is sallow; ruddy and tanned are opposite.

quests.question: A first-time user opened the app and found every button without a manual; its design is _____.
quests.explanation: Finding every button without a manual shows the design is natural to use: intuitive.

quests.question: The clinic is across town, closes at four and has no parking; for workers it is _____.
quests.explanation: Distance, an early closing and no parking make visits hard for workers, so inconvenient fits.

quests.question: 'Don't touch my things,' she said _____, cutting him off.
quests.explanation: A command that cuts someone off is delivered with edge, so sharply fits; gently and warmly don't.

quests.question: The reporter slipped into the war zone to film, risking everything; his _____ spirit made him famous.
quests.explanation: Entering a war zone to film and risking everything shows fearless adventure: intrepid.

quests.question: Denied a second dessert, the boy folded his arms and pouted like a spoiled child; he was _____.
quests.explanation: Folding arms and pouting over a refused dessert shows sulky bad temper: petulant.

quests.question: Whistling and humming as she watered the plants, Omar seemed _____ all morning.
quests.explanation: Whistling and humming are signs of good spirits, so cheerful fits; sullen and gloomy contradict.

quests.question: Nobody coughed or whispered; the library was completely _____.
quests.explanation: No coughing or whispering means no sound at all, so silent fits; rowdy and noisy contradict.

quests.question: He eats vegetables, runs daily and sleeps eight hours; he is _____.
quests.explanation: Eating vegetables, daily running and good sleep are habits of good health, so healthy fits.

quests.question: Everything annoyed him: the coffee, the traffic, the chair; he stayed _____ all day.
quests.explanation: Being annoyed by coffee, traffic and a chair shows irritability over small things: peevish.

quests.question: Slippery rocks, a steep drop and no railing made the path extremely _____.
quests.explanation: Slippery rocks, a steep drop and no railing all raise the risk of a fall, so dangerous fits.

quests.question: Warned of the storm, the explorer set out alone anyway, showing no fear; she was _____.
quests.explanation: Setting out alone despite a storm warning and showing no fear means she is fearless: dauntless.
